method: targeted Kyrgyz-English semantic review against printed page and adjacent context; inventory-142 manuscript alignment remains provisional
checked_by: Codex with parallel agent proposals reviewed by root

uncertainty.note: Кызык өмүр топтуу жан is the 2012 PDF text but its meaning is unclear and differs from 1960. No correction proposed; preserve this witness and obtain specialist review.
Кыялдуу мүшкүл кыр болуп is semantically obscure. No correction proposed; scan and other witnesses should be consulted.
Толук канды жутушуп is unusually phrased; rendering blood-drinking as hyperbolic and literal.

uncertainty: Rows 42-46 have compressed reciprocal syntax; verify against printed page before accepting pronouns.
Row 57 үрөлүп inferred as weariness or strength spent from context and parallel usage; confirm with a Kyrgyz specialist.
Rows 59-60 Артык жаңжал бөлүнүп / Чамалуусу чаксыздын have unclear syntax, particularly чаксыздын; keep tentative.
Rows 78-80 syntax and punctuation continue into page 983; edit in context if integrated.
Line 14 and line 38 retain provisional literal English pending specialist reading of the 2012 witness.
Line 60 Чамалуусу чаксыздын remains grammatically and lexically uncertain.

corrections.reason: Бир бирине карабай describes mutual disregard in the duel.
Кылча жанын аябай is the epic image of life as thin as a hair; аябай means not sparing.
Context and 1960 witness read балаалуу 'fraught with calamity'; 2012's балалуу may be a typo, but 'childish' is unsupported.

corrections.en: Both of them, their dear lives
corrections.reason: Байкуш жанды is object of following line; refers to both combatants' lives.

corrections.old: Tied to the grass and thrown
corrections.reason: Кылга байлап ташташып is an idiom for risking their lives.
Жаңжал is armed conflict here; дуу болуп describes its din.
Retains the striking image of толук канды жутушуп without an unsupported interpretation.

corrections.en: Tearing all their coats to shreds.
corrections.reason: Тон is coat, and тытышып is mutual tearing.

corrections.old: Don't flinch if they are beaten.
corrections.en: When they struck with clubs, neither flinched;
corrections.reason: Reciprocal past action, not an imperative or generic conditional.

corrections.en: When they hacked with axes, neither stirred;
corrections.reason: Балталашса is reciprocal axe fighting, былк этпей is without stirring.

corrections.old: If you are whipped, don't cry.
corrections.en: When they lashed with whips, neither cried out;
corrections.reason: Reciprocal whip fighting; каңк этпей means without yelping.

corrections.en: When they crossed swords, neither uttered a groan;
corrections.reason: Кылычташса explicitly refers to swords; кыңк этпей is without a groan.
Kыйын describes severity; passage is a duel continuing two days.

corrections.old: A person with an interesting life,
corrections.en: A strange life, a soul amid a throng,
corrections.reason: Provisional literal reading of the printed Кызык өмүр топтуу жан; the 1960 parallel differs. Exact sense unresolved.

corrections.old: Tied to the grass and thrown
corrections.en: They staked it on a single hair;
corrections.reason: Repeated risk-life idiom; 'it' refers to life/soul in line 14.

corrections.en: A precious life, a dear soul,
corrections.reason: Кызык өмүр is 'remarkable/precious life' in parallel with таттуу жан.

corrections.old: He tied it to the grass and left it.
corrections.en: They staked it on a single hair.
corrections.reason: The idiom means put life at risk; singular ending of 2012 source may be narrator variation, so plural subject is contextual.

corrections.en: A bloody slaughter, a relentless pursuit,
corrections.reason: Кызыл кыргын evokes bloodshed; куу сүргүн is harsh pursuit/driving-away, not cunning exile.

corrections.en: They led their champions into it.
corrections.reason: Кыраандарын are their champions/valiant men; баштаптыр means led/brought forth.

corrections.en: Seizing each other by the collars,
corrections.reason: Жакалашып is grappling by the collar; чоюшуп is pulling/dragging.
Жакын келип калганын is object of next line, a person who comes close.
Балта менен коюшуп describes axe blows.

corrections.old: Day and night for two days
corrections.reason: Idiomatic English rendering of Күнү-түнү эки күн.

corrections.en: They never ceased their thunderous clash.
corrections.reason: Күпүлдөшүп indicates rumbling or booming, not laughter; plural reciprocal ending.
Күүлөнүшүп is to gather momentum/energy, not tune in.
Күрпүлдөшүп is reciprocal roaring/rumbling in battle.

corrections.old: The town is in full swing.
corrections.reason: Касаба is a banner/standard in epic usage; кайнап conveys seething multitude, туу reinforces banner.

corrections.en: Battle cries rose in a tumult;
corrections.reason: Айгайлаган чуу is a clamorous cry, not generic noise.

corrections.old: If you look, there is a sound,
corrections.reason: Карасаң addresses observer; дүмөк дуу is the violent uproar.
Калың жаңжал is a massive fight; context is battle.

corrections.en: They tore at one another without regret,
corrections.reason: Арманы жок is 'without regret'; тытышып is reciprocal tearing.

corrections.en: Swallowing blood as if it were water,
corrections.reason: Preserves hyperbolic source image and participial syntax.

corrections.en: They thrust their spears at one another,
corrections.reason: Сунуп найза алышты depicts mutual spear attack.
Кайран жанын аябай is third-person 'not sparing their dear lives'; no first-person speaker.
Талкалашып салышты is violent mutual fighting, beyond a verbal quarrel.

corrections.en: There was no way out of it,
corrections.reason: Мындан айла болгон жок refers to the inescapable battle.

corrections.en: They were enveloped in pitch-black dust,
corrections.reason: Бөлөнүп means becoming covered or enveloped, not disintegration.

corrections.en: A strange hardship rose like a ridge,
corrections.reason: Provisional literal rendering of the obscure printed Кыялдуу мүшкүл кыр болуп; exact sense unresolved.

corrections.en: A fierce tumult and strife arose,
corrections.reason: Кыйын дүмөк чыр болуп continues the battle din, past narration.

corrections.old: There was a noise in the sky,
corrections.en: A clamor seemed to split the sky,
corrections.reason: Асман жарган is sky-splitting hyperbole.

corrections.en: The cries rose in a roar,
corrections.reason: Айгайлаган and дуу describe the battle's cries and din.
Keeps the reciprocal battle context without assigning an unsupported singular subject.
Reciprocal inability in the duel; avoids unsupported male pronoun.
The line begins the reciprocal thought Чын эсебин бир бири, concerning the other's true measure.
Табыша албай means they could not find it; follows the previous line.

corrections.en: Each was a formidable trial to the other,
corrections.reason: Улуу мүшкүл бир бирөө describes both fighters as a great difficulty; phrasing is compressed.

corrections.en: And neither could defeat the other.
corrections.reason: Салыша means contend or fight, not compare.
Уйпалашып is reciprocal of уйпала: trample, crush or maul; not embrace.

corrections.en: Yet neither could bring the other down.
corrections.reason: Алыша албай continues reciprocal fighting; exact nuance could also be 'could not overcome each other'.
Жер бузулуп термелип depicts the ground being torn and trembling.
Экөөнүн күчү тең келип means the two had equal strength.

corrections.en: They struck without gaining the upper hand,
corrections.reason: Чапчышып means exchanging blows, чама жете албай means unable to prevail.
Талкалашып and салышып are reciprocal combat verbs, not arguing.

corrections.en: Yet neither could prevail against the other.
corrections.reason: Бир бирине жете албай: neither could reach/overcome the other in the fight.

corrections.en: A mighty clash, a great din,
corrections.reason: Улуу жаңжал, калың дуу: battle and its roar.
Ушундай болуп ызы-чуу sums up the tumult.

corrections.old: All the people are blown away,
corrections.reason: үрөлүп denotes expending/wearing down strength in this battle context, not being blown away.

corrections.old: The spear collapsed and ran out.
corrections.en: Their spears shattered and were used up.
corrections.reason: Найза кыйрап түгөнүп: spears broke and were exhausted.
Артык жаңжал бөлүнүп describes an exceptional battle spreading/breaking out; exact imagery remains uncertain.

corrections.en: The strong drove the weak before them,
corrections.reason: Чамалуусу чаксыздын runs into next line; чамалуу may mean those with strength, чаксыз those without means/strength. Lexical distinction is uncertain.

corrections.en: And slaughtered them as they went,
corrections.reason: Айдап жүрүп союшуп: driving/chasing and slaying; completes previous line.

corrections.old: Excessive conflict is a great sound,
corrections.en: A great clash and mighty roar,
corrections.reason: Артык жаңжал улуу дуу describes exceptional battle and din, not excess conflict.

corrections.en: A throng of cries and clamor.
corrections.reason: Калың айгай ызы-чуу denotes many battle cries and commotion.
Катуу мүшкүл болду эми: grave hardship in battle.

corrections.old: It is known that the khan died.
corrections.reason: Белгилүүдөн хан өлүп: famous/known khans died; хан is khan, not causal 'it is known'.

corrections.old: Face to face, all souls die,
corrections.en: And warriors meeting face to face died,
corrections.reason: Беттешип жандын баары өлүп: those engaging face to face died; 'all' is epic hyperbole.
Бейпай denotes trouble, suffering or hardship in epic usage, rather than merely ruthless conduct.

corrections.old: This soul is not called alive,
corrections.en: As if these lives were not living,
corrections.reason: Тирүү дебей бу жанды: they disregarded living lives; flows into next line.
Тим эле таштап коюшту: merely cast them aside, referring to lives in prior line.
Кармаш кылган кан өлүп: кан is khan in context of preceding хан өлүп, not blood clots; orthography varies.
Катуу жаңжал салышып: they fought a severe battle.
Калбай жүрүп эрендер seems to describe champions persisting without respite; exact syntax uncertain.
Карсылдашып калышып evokes a crashing collision.
Өлүм ажал балаага names death/fate/misfortune as destination of the attack; dative is resolved in next line.
Жоого эле минтип барышып: thus they went against the enemy; completes previous line.
Чама чарчап ал кетип: capacity/strength tired and departed; no personal name Chama.

corrections.old: Er Sarybay is a great hero,
corrections.reason: Эр Сарыбай чоң баатыр names and praises the warrior.

corrections.old: People don't know what people see.
corrections.en: A man the people had never known the like of,
corrections.reason: Адам көрүп эл билбес praises Sarybay as exceptional; word order/subject compressed.
Дууга салып турду эми: he was bringing/keeping the battle's din, not praying.
Айгайлаган бу жаңжал continues into page 983's Чууга салып турду эле; punctuation and verb may be revised with following line.
